headline: ChatGPT dominance in federal AI spending raises clinical governance questions
body: ChatGPT accounts for 80% of identifiable House AI spending, according to new analysis, while parallel concerns emerge about the platform's role in high-profile incidents. For healthcare organizations evaluating generative AI tools for clinical workflows and EHR integration, this spending concentration signals both market validation and regulatory risk. The federal footprint suggests healthcare systems should expect increased scrutiny around their own ChatGPT deployments, particularly in sensitive clinical decision-support contexts. Healthcare AI consultants should advise clients that vendor concentration creates both cost leverage opportunities and single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities in critical care environments.
